verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the beach town of Forte dei Marmi on the Tuscan coast, among palm and pine trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: And nestled in its redolent landscape of palm and pine trees, you’ll find Principe Forte dei Marmi,

verified_facts.text: Lux Lucis is home to the Michelin-starred cuisine of Chef Valentino Cassanelli.
verified_facts.excerpt: LUX LUCIS is home to the Michelin-starred cuisine of Chef Valentino Cassanelli.

verified_facts.text: The 67 Sky Lounge sits on the hotel's panoramic rooftop, overlooking the Versilia coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the panoramic rooftop of Principe Forte dei Marmi hotel, the 67 Sky Lounge offers an exclusive and dynamic environment overlooking the entire Versilia coast

verified_facts.text: Dalmazia restaurant, framed by verandas facing the beach and open sea, serves Versilia flavors with a menu created by Chef Valentino Cassanelli.
verified_facts.excerpt: Framed by large verandas with an incomparable view of the beach and the open sea, at Dalmazia restaurant you will live an authentic experience made up of typical smells and flavors of Versilia

verified_facts.text: The Principe restaurant looks onto the garden and pool area and serves international cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Framed by a large window that blends into the elegant and luxuriant outdoor garden and the pool area, the Principe restaurant is a small oasis

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool sits in the hotel's garden, with Balinese tents, deck chairs and a pool bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complete relax at the open-air swimming pool with a dedicated area with Balinese tents and deck chairs, pool bar.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool and pool bar open seasonally from April to October.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal Opening from April to October

verified_facts.text: The Egoista Spa has an indoor heated pool, whirlpool, Finnish sauna, bio sauna, Turkish bath and an ice cascade.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the indoor heated swimming pool of 14 meters, whirlpool, Finnish sauna, bio sauna, Turkish bath, hot/cold emotional showers, ice cascade, and relaxation area with a tea corner.

verified_facts.text: Rooms use minimal design with exclusively Made in Italy furniture and accessories.
verified_facts.excerpt: minimal design, bright spaces and furnishings with exclusively Made in Italy furniture and accessories.

verified_facts.text: Open Space suites have floor-to-ceiling French windows overlooking the garden and the Apuan Alps.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling French windows overlooking the garden and the Apuan Alps, our local mountains.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a 24-meter Mazarin yacht with a flybridge and three cabins.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our 24-meter Mazarin yacht features a flybridge and three cabins

verified_facts.text: Arte al Principe is a hotel project showcasing contemporary art, including marble and granite sculptures by Korean artist Park Eun-Sun.
verified_facts.excerpt: The heart of the "Arte al Principe" project is the collaboration with Park Eun-Sun, an internationally renowned Korean artist. His marble and granite sculptures

verified_facts.text: Works by sculptor Romolo Del Deo are displayed on the hotel's panoramic rooftop.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the hotel’s panoramic rooftop, Romolo Del Deo’s works engage with the sea, the light and the Versilia horizon

verified_facts.text: Activities for children and teens include private tennis and golf lessons, guided bike tours and children's pastry workshops.
verified_facts.excerpt: Highlights include private tennis and golf lessons, guided bike tours, children's pastry workshops

verified_facts.text: The hotel arranges experiences at the marble quarries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Forte dei Marmi’s most iconic experience. The world of marble is rooted in ancient history
